mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates lower inflationary pressures, leading to a potential decrease in interest rates and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where CPI decreases by >0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by >5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by >1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in real GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals weakening consumer demand and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreases and UNRATE increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a single meeting
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25% in a single meeting.
